text:
Nora: Alert from SLOs: spike in TLS handshake errors in eu-west after last night's RBAC push. Posting for immediate triage.
Ravi: saw it. nginx shows 'tls: bad certificate' and keystore logs show unwrap DENY.
Elaine: the change tightened keystore:unwrap to svc-keystore but forgot regional aliases (svc-keystore-eu, svc-keystore-eu-alt).
KMSBot: [alert] 2 KMS:Decrypt DENY events principal=svc-keystore-eu-alt req=req-c21 at 6160001256.
Nora: Can we do a scoped emergency grant limited by resource and TTL? Prefer audit-high.
Elaine: I'll apply `iam-policy grant --principal svc-keystore-eu-alt --action keystore:unwrap --resource arn:keystore:eu:leaf/* --ttl 6160004800 --audit=high` and post audit link.
KMSBot: [info] policy applied id=pol-tempeu at 6160001310. KMS:Decrypt SUCCESS req=req-c23 at 6160001322.
Ravi: handshakes recovering, errors dropping. Good.
OpsOnCall: Pushed proxy pin annotation to reduce churn: `kubectl annotate deploy proxy-eu pinned-cert=true`. Keep rollback snippet: `iam-policy revoke --id=pol-tempeu`.
Nora: Follow-ups: (1) add regional principal mapping to RBAC PR checklist, (2) CI preflight to simulate unwrap per region, (3) add audit rule for keystore:unwrap grants. I'll file the incident ticket.
Elaine: Filed RED-9993 with diffs and audit snapshot. Attaching runbook notes and expiration time.
Nora: Thanks team. We'll leave this thread open for RCA updates.
